tracks.title: Time to Let Go
tracks.sourceFolder: Whispers of the Heart Country Ballads for the Soul

lyrics.rawText:
I’ve been holdin’ on to memories too tight, Tryin’ to make sense of every sleepless night. But every picture fades, every story ends, It’s time to say goodbye, my old friend.
I thought the weight would lift if I held on strong, But it’s time I admit, I’ve been holdin’ on too long. The past can’t heal what the heart needs to grow, It’s time to let go.
Time to let go, leave the pain behind, Chase the light that I’ve been tryin’ to find. With every tear, I’m finding my way, A little stronger with each new day. Time to let go, time to be free, The road ahead is callin’ me. I’ll take a breath, I’ll take it slow, But I know it’s time to let go.
I’ve been countin’ every mistake I made, Stackin’ them up like a price I paid. But I’ve learned the hard way that the past don’t change, It’s time I step outside the rain.
I thought if I stayed in the comfort of the pain, It might make sense and I’d heal again. But now I see the future’s waitin’ below, It’s time to let go.
Time to let go, leave the pain behind, Chase the light that I’ve been tryin’ to find. With every tear, I’m finding my way, A little stronger with each new day. Time to let go, time to be free, The road ahead is callin’ me. I’ll take a breath, I’ll take it slow, But I know it’s time to let go.
The weight on my heart is lighter today, I’m breakin’ free, and I’ll find my way. What’s behind me can stay in the past, I’m ready for a love that lasts.

tracks.title: where the heart is
tracks.sourceFolder: Whispers of the Heart Country Ballads for the Soul

lyrics.rawText:
There’s a house at the end of a dirt road lane, With a front porch swing and a windowpane. Momma’s in the kitchen hummin’ that tune, Daddy’s fixin’ things like he always used to do.
Every time I come back home, I find, The love I need is here, time after time.
‘Cause home’s where the heart is, it’s where I belong, With laughter and love, where we’re always strong. Through the highs and the lows, through thick and thin, Family’s the place where life begins. No matter how far I may roam, I always know that home’s where the heart is.
There’s a picture on the wall from days gone by, A little bit faded, but it still makes me smile. Sunday dinners ‘round the table so wide, With stories and laughter, we’re all side by side.
And when the world feels heavy on my mind, Family’s the shelter that I know I’ll find.
‘Cause home’s where the heart is, it’s where I belong, With laughter and love, where we’re always strong. Through the highs and the lows, through thick and thin, Family’s the place where life begins. No matter how far I may roam, I always know that home’s where the heart is.
No matter the miles, no matter the years, Family’s the reason I’ve got no fears. It’s in every hug, it’s in every smile, It’s where I’ll be, even for a little while.
‘Cause home’s where the heart is, it’s where I belong, With laughter and love, where we’re always strong. Through the highs and the lows, through thick and thin, Family’s the place where life begins. No matter how far I may roam, I always know that home’s where the heart is.
Yeah, no matter how far I may roam, Home’s where the heart is… it’s where I belong.

You showed me how to stand up tall, You caught me every time I’d fall. Through every storm, through every fight, You’ve been my strength, my guiding light.
Mama’s heart, so strong and true, With every beat, I owe it all to you. You gave me love, you gave me hope, Taught me how to hold on, how to cope. From the day I was born to the man I became, Mama’s heart is where I’ll always stay. No matter how far I roam, I know, I’ll carry with me, Mama’s heart wherever I go.
I’ve seen you work through sleepless nights, Sacrificin’ your own dreams just to make mine right. You never asked for anything, just gave your all, Mama, you were there through it all.
Now I see the road you paved for me, All the love you gave so selflessly. You taught me how to live and love, And for that, I’ll never thank you enough.
Mama’s heart, so strong and true, With every beat, I owe it all to you. You gave me love, you gave me hope, Taught me how to hold on, how to cope. From the day I was born to the man I became, Mama’s heart is where I’ll always stay. No matter how far I roam, I know, I’ll carry with me, Mama’s heart wherever I go.
And when the world gets rough, and I’m feelin’ small, I’ll hear your voice and remember it all. The lessons you taught, the love that you gave, Are the treasures in my heart that I’ll always save.
Mama’s heart, so strong and true, With every beat, I owe it all to you. You gave me love, you gave me hope, Taught me how to hold on, how to cope. From the day I was born to the man I became, Mama’s heart is where I’ll always stay. No matter how far I roam, I know, I’ll carry with me, Mama’s heart wherever I go.

tracks.title: roots run deep
tracks.sourceFolder: Whispers of the Heart Country Ballads for the Soul

lyrics.rawText:
There’s an old oak tree in the backyard shade, It’s stood through every storm we’ve faced. Grandpa built this house with his own two hands, It’s the heart of this old piece of land.
Every scar, every story, every tear, It’s what keeps us all still standin’ here.
Our roots run deep, through the soil and the stone, Through every mile we’ve wandered, we’ve never been alone. With every generation, the love stays strong, Through the winds of change, it’s where we belong. We might grow tall, we might break free, But no matter how far we go, our roots run deep.
Sunday dinners ‘round the kitchen table, With prayers and stories, passin' down those fables. Daddy taught me how to be a man, Mama showed me love, always holdin’ my hand.
No matter where life pulls us away, This family’s what keeps me anchored, come what may. Our roots run deep.
Through the roots run deep, through the soil and the stone, Through every mile we’ve wandered, we’ve never been alone. With every generation, the love stays strong, Through the winds of change, it’s where we belong. We might grow tall, we might break free, But no matter how far we go, our roots run deep.
Years may pass, and we’ll all grow old, But the love we share is worth more than gold. Through every step, I know I’ll see, This family’s always a part of me.
Our roots run deep, through the soil and the stone, Through every mile we’ve wandered, we’ve never been alone. With every generation, the love stays strong, Through the winds of change, it’s where we belong. We might grow tall, we might break free, But no matter how far we go, our roots run deep.
Yeah, no matter how far we go, Our roots run deep, and they always show.

tracks.title: When You Walked In
tracks.sourceFolder: Whispers of the Heart Country Ballads for the Soul

lyrics.rawText:
I was sittin’ by the window, watchin’ the rain, Another quiet night, feelin’ the same. Wasn’t lookin’ for nothin’, just passin’ time, Then you walked in, and changed my mind.
You had a smile that lit up the room, Like the first taste of spring after winter’s gloom. I never saw it comin’, but now I see, You were what I needed to set me free.
When you walked in, my whole world changed, The colors got brighter, and the seasons rearranged. You turned my quiet into something true, I didn’t know love ‘til I found you. Now every step, every breath I take, Feels like a dream I don’t wanna shake. When you walked in, love found me, And I’m right where I’m meant to be.
I wasn’t lookin’ for love, just goin’ my way, But your eyes told me more than words could say. Now the nights don’t feel so long, With you beside me, I’m right where I belong.

Yeah

Now every step, every breath I take, Feels like a dream I don’t wanna shake. When you walked in, love found me, And I’m right where I’m meant to be.
When you walked in, love found me, But now, I’m right where I’m meant to be.

tracks.title: Endless as the Sky
tracks.sourceFolder: Whispers of the Heart Country Ballads for the Soul

lyrics.rawText:

The winds may change, the tides may turn, But my heart for you will always burn. In every breath, in every sigh, Our love is endless as the sky.
Endless as the sky, unbroken and free, A love that knows no limits, just you and me. Through every storm, through every night, I’ll hold you close and love you right. Endless as the sky, our love will rise, Forever in your arms, I’ll find my paradise.

The seasons pass, the stars may fade, But our love’s a light that won’t dissuade. In every breath, in every sigh, Our love will soar and never die.
Endless as the sky, unbroken and free, A love that knows no limits, just you and me. Through every storm, through every night, I’ll hold you close and love you right. Endless as the sky, our love will rise, Forever in your arms, I’ll find my paradise.

Endless as the sky, unbroken and free, A love that knows no limits, just you and me. Through every storm, through every night, I’ll hold you close and love you right. Endless as the sky, our love will rise, Forever in your arms, I’ll find my paradise.

Endless as the sky.

She’s the light in every stormy day, The one who guides me, come what may. With every moment, every smile, She makes this life feel so worthwhile.

tracks.title: Every day I miss you
tracks.sourceFolder: Whispers of the Heart Country Ballads for the Soul

I keep moving, but it feels so wrong.
In this town, I still see,
The ghost of us, where we used to be.

I’m right where we used to be,

The echoes linger, but you’re long gone,
I keep moving, but it feels so wrong.

She’s the calm when the world’s too loud, She’s the reason I’m standing proud. With every touch, with every kiss, I thank the Lord for love like this.

Every word she says, every glance, Feels like my heart’s taken another chance. She’s the one that I hold so dear, With her love, I’ve got nothin’ to fear.
